model_architecture:
Model(
  (conv1): Conv1d(14, 32, kernel_size=(3,), stride=(1,), padding=(1,))
  (tanh_cnn): Tanh()
  (lstm): LSTM(32, 64, batch_first=True)
  (linear_1): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
  (tanh): Tanh()
  (fc): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=24, bias=True)
)
forward_code:
def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)               # (batch, input_size, seq_len)
        x = self.tanh_cnn(self.conv1(x))         # (batch, cnn_channels, seq_len)
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)               # (batch, seq_len, cnn_channels)

        output, _ = self.lstm(x)
        x = output[:, -1, :]
        x = self.linear_1(x)
        x = self.tanh(x)
        return self.fc(x)
